steps.name: forest at sunset
steps.objective: Go to [Agent Usher] at the “Guild Inn”.

steps.name: an unusual sign
steps.objective: Defeat the 'Naive Snail' and 'General Ant' in the "Forest of the Sunset" and report to [Agent Usher] at the "Guild Inn".

lines.speaker: 에이전트 어셔
lines.text: Ah! Adventurer is here!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I received a request for help from Detective Zenon.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did something bad happen here?

lines.speaker: 에이전트 어셔
lines.text: I can't say for sure right now, but... .

lines.speaker: 에이전트 어셔
lines.text: The forest ecosystem is becoming strange.

lines.speaker: 에이전트 어셔
lines.text: Because it’s an unusual omen… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It seems like Usher couldn't do anything with his strength.

lines.speaker: 에이전트 어셔
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: 에이전트 어셔
lines.text: So I asked for help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So, can I just search the forest?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It would be better to find out why the forest became strange... ?

lines.speaker: 에이전트 어셔
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: 에이전트 어셔
lines.text: Actually, I have a guess, but I'm not sure... .

lines.speaker: 에이전트 어셔
lines.text: Anyway, please do your research.

steps.name: Pollution progress (1)
steps.objective: Defeat 'Naive Snail', 'Relentless Trench', and 'Rainbow Psyche' in "Forest of the Sunset" and report to [Agent Usher] at the "Guild Inn".

lines.speaker: 에이전트 어셔
lines.text: In fact, we are conducting research in various parts of the world at the request of the Imperial Family of Giendia.

lines.speaker: 에이전트 어셔
lines.text: He asked me to figure out the cause because the dimensional gap is opening irregularly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A dimensional gap?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could it be related to Iris?

lines.speaker: 에이전트 어셔
lines.text: I guess it seems like that.

lines.speaker: 에이전트 어셔
lines.text: It seems like it's connected to the demon world or another world... .

lines.speaker: 에이전트 어셔
lines.text: It's definitely not a good place.

lines.speaker: 에이전트 어셔
lines.text: Because the energy that escapes from the cracks is changing our ecosystem.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's going on with Iris... .

lines.speaker: 에이전트 어셔
lines.text: Yes? What is that... ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, it's nothing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Anyway, now that I know the situation… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go in again and investigate for sure.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's no one else's business anymore.

lines.speaker: 에이전트 어셔
lines.text: Among the information we found out… .

lines.speaker: 에이전트 어셔
lines.text: There was a rumor that the strongest life form in the contaminated area was controlling the area around the dimensional gap.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it to hog your energy?

lines.speaker: 에이전트 어셔
lines.text: Yes. Even though the energy is dirty, once you accept it, it becomes stronger.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's dangerous.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will enter the forest once again.

steps.name: Pollution progress (2)
steps.objective: Defeat the ‘Mutant Flower Snake’ in the ‘Forest of the Sunset’ and report to [Agent Usher] at the ‘Guild Inn’.

lines.speaker: 에이전트 어셔
lines.text: Since it is literally a gap, it will be difficult to find.

lines.speaker: 에이전트 어셔
lines.text: So, look for the strongest or abnormally mutated monsters.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm still looking, but it's not easy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Still, if I search a little more, I think I might find something... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mr. Usher is here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go in again and search until I find something.

lines.speaker: 에이전트 어셔
lines.text: Yes. Take care of yourself.

lines.speaker: 에이전트 어셔
lines.text: I'm so glad you came back safely.

lines.speaker: 에이전트 어셔
lines.text: No matter how long I waited, there was no news, so I was very worried.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nothing dangerous happened.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I also found abnormal monsters and killed them... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm, somehow I couldn't see the gap.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Still, I removed everything that looked dangerous.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please bring along someone who can perform purification techniques and conduct a search.

lines.speaker: 에이전트 어셔
lines.text: I see. thank you so much.

lines.speaker: 에이전트 어셔
lines.text: It must have been a difficult request... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It wasn't a big deal.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Just a warm-up... Anyway, I have work to do so I'll go somewhere else.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you have any problems, please contact me at any time.

lines.speaker: 에이전트 어셔
lines.text: I am indebted to you this time too.

lines.speaker: 에이전트 어셔
lines.text: Until we see you again, take care.
